## About
Mungenast Automotive Reconditioning is on Manchester Rd in Des Peres. We handle the cosmetic work that makes a car look right again: dents and hail damage, curb rash on wheels, foggy headlights, bumpers, windshield chips and paint chips.
Our PDR technicians remove dents without sanding, filling, or repainting, so the original factory finish stays intact. For paint chips, our team mixes the factory paint color instead of sanding and repainting the panel.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 73 Google reviews.

## Services
- Dent Repair: Paintless dent removal for dents and dings from hail, shopping carts and other minor accidents. Our PDR technicians remove the dent without affecting the paint finish. (Starting at $59.99 per dent)
- Wheel Repair: We fix peeling clear coats to curb rash and turn your wheel back to the original condition. (Starting at $125.00 a wheel)
- Headlight Restoration: Foggy, hazy or yellowed headlights restored to their former brightness using specialized compounds and polishes. (Starting at $149.00)
- Bumper Repair: Bumper repairs and replacements. Stop in for a complimentary estimate. (Starting at $675.00)
- Windshield Chips: A chip can spread and turn into a windshield replacement. We can fix windshield chips up to the diameter of a quarter. (Starting at $59.00)
- Paint Touch-up: Chips from gravel, sand, rocks and salt, filled with mixed factory paint color and no sanding or repainting of the vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How long does paintless dent repair take?
A: PDR is a quick process, usually taking only a few hours, depending on the size and complexity of the dent.

Q: Is headlight restoration covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a 1-year warranty on the headlight restoration process.

Q: Will I get a loaner car for wheel repairs?
A: A loaner vehicle is provided with two or more wheel repairs. For other work, ask when you stop in for your estimate.
